introduction: Agim and Erjon have built fundamentally different lives in Germany and Italy and return to Albania because of their father Ilir's illness.But they arrive too late: Ilir has already died. Left alone with their feelings, things become even more complicated for the brothers when they come across Ilir's last wish. In an attempt to fulfill it somehow, the brothers have to come to terms with their relationship with each other and with their home country, which has changed as much as they have since they fled over 30 years ago.Agim和Erijon在德国和意大利建立了截然不同的生活，他们因为父亲Ilir重病而返回阿尔巴尼亚。但他们赶到时已经太晚了，父亲已经去世。兄弟俩独自面对着各自的悲伤，而当他们发现Ilir的遗愿时，事情变得更加复杂。为了尽力实现这一遗愿，兄弟俩不得不重新审视彼此之间的关系，以及他们与祖国的关系。自30年前他们逃离家园以来，阿尔巴尼亚已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
